d:
Some feelings can't be spoken, they only fall as hanju Watch Hanju, an emotional Punjabi song in Gippy Grewal's heartfelt voice, now brought to life in a stunning new visual.
Gippy Grewal's raw, soulful vocals carry every bit of the pain, making this one for the quiet nights when the heart feels heavy
Song Credits
Song : Hanju
Album : Desi Rockstar 2
Singer : Gippy Grewal
Editor : D Pee Gill
Label : Speed Records
